lane: datum-offset: Lake Lahontan shorelines as a strain gauge
hypothesis: The Lahontan highstand shoreline is an isochronous near-level datum formed immediately prior to 13.07 +/- 0.06 ka. After removing a smooth isobase (isostatic rebound + regional tilt), abrupt steps and lateral deflections of that datum mark faults that displace the shoreline. The competition's hidden labels are expert-identified faults absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue, and a shoreline offset is exactly the surface expression an expert maps.
mechanism: Wave-planed highstand benches are mapped in the DEM inside the published deformed-elevation window (1313.5-1345.8 m); a robust 2-D polynomial isobase is fitted to the bench elevations; residuals above the published 3 m elevation resolution, and azimuth changes above 35 deg between nearby elongated benches, are flagged; a trace is seeded at each flag and extended while the local structure tensor (coherence >= 0.15, cross-strike relief >= 4 m) supports it; unit dots are emitted at 300 m kernel-matched spacing with a 200 m catalogue exclusion.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: (a) Beach-ridge constructional scatter -- crests build 1-3 m above still water, which is why the step threshold defaults to the published 3 m resolution; (b) fluvial and deltaic terraces graded to lower still-water levels, which sit inside the elevation window without being the highstand datum; (c) alluvial-fan and bajada construction surfaces that are flat enough to pass the slope gate; (d) eolian (dune) crests; (e) differential rebound and sediment compaction producing steps at the lake-margin sediment/bedrock contact with no fault.

holdout.label: HOLDOUT-DTI
holdout.evaluator: gems62.holdout.v1 (4 spatial quadrants, whole segments, 300 m buffer)
holdout.design: 4 spatial quadrants; whole 8-connected catalogue segments withheld per fold; visible faults masked pixel-exactly out of the scored footprint; a 300 m gap around visible faults is excluded from false-positive accounting; truth is never dilated
holdout.leak_free_reason: the lane does not read the catalogue for placement (the only catalogue term is an exclusion gate that can only remove mass), so withheld positives cannot help it
holdout.validity_note: Catalogue-truth proxy. The competition target is faults ABSENT from the catalogue; they are masked out of scoring, so this number cannot measure the lane's performance on the real target. It is a leak-free lower bound on recovering a mapped-fault population.

score_model.label: MODEL (algebra on the published metric with an inherited G input), NOT a score and NOT a projection written as a score

upload_decision: DO NOT SPEND A WEEKLY SLOT. Unique, format-valid, OK TO DOWNLOAD for inspection, but the hard upper bound at 225 dots is 0.0233. Protocol gate 'not beaten the current holdout best' is not met.
lane_rule_note: Both halves of the binding rule are recorded: the surface check ran BEFORE placement on the datum-offset surface (this field) and on its flagged-evidence subset, and the final-dots check is the correlation_overlap_vs_registry field. Same evaluator, same limits.
